help_extra: - /start : Show welcome message and base settings
guide_subtitle: Follow these steps to set up your Telegram bot:
guide_step_0_p2: 2. Send /newbot and follow instructions to set name/username.
guide_step_0_p3: 3. Copy the HTTP API Token and paste it in the field below.
guide_step_0_proxy: * If connection times out, try enabling 'Global Proxy'.
guide_step_1_desc: Search for your bot username and click Start to begin chatting.
guide_step_2_desc: Bot must be added as an Administrator in the channel to receive messages.
guide_step_2_tip: 💡 Tip: Trigger dialogue via @BotUsername or Replying to a message.
guide_step_3_p1: Add bot to group. It's recommended to configure in @BotFather:
guide_step_3_p3: Disabling Privacy Mode helps the bot understand group context better.
